title: P15 — Implement exact voice timing and cache v1
description:
## Dispatch packet P15
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D07 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
toolchain; player and cli for authoritative frozen-timing consumption
Primary paths: src/generate.ts; cache-resolver.ts; audio/wav.ts. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Use measured samples per segment, explicit silence, canonical cache identity and pronunciation capability checks. Freeze/validate generated WAV metadata and preserve Auritus provenance. Do not modify Auritus hosted hashes.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
text/speed/model/reference changes invalidate relevant cache; repeated run reuses; pause sample counts exact; corruption rejected.

## Dependencies
videoml-fcfbb1 (P14)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Primary integration decisions
P15 is incomplete until playback and export consume the validated frozen timing as authoritative. Generating timeline.resolved.json alone is insufficient. Read player/cli AGENTS before their integration edits; stdlib remains under P06 ownership. Record actual FFmpeg version/build configuration in processing provenance and cache identity; reject reuse when it changes. A pinned Linux toolchain remains the release reproducibility gate; local macOS evidence does not satisfy it. Hash both Auritus modelRevision and extensions["auritus.kokoro"].voiceRevision and fail closed on unknown identity or non-null cacheDisabledReason.
## Qualified identity encoding
For globally unique resolved IDs use kind + colon + JSON.stringify(array of exact original path IDs). Include scene/layer scope as required; delimiter/unicode IDs must not collide. Share producer/consumer encoder through proper package exports. Internal audio segments lacking source IDs may append a numeric document-segment index to their full cue path; this never authorizes DOM matching by index. Reordered/edited source invalidates source correspondence. Document the scheme in specification prose and test adversarial IDs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: P01 smoke exposed existing dry-run generation failure when no pause/audio segment creates output directories. P15 must include no-pause narrated and visual-only fixtures and remove need to precreate segments; mocked audio remains explicitly labeled simulated. Do not count a fixture workaround as a product fix.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary source review: scoped tests pass but acceptance remains open. Required fixes: compare returned synthesis voiceRevision with capability identity before cache writes; accumulate consecutive pause sample runs; resolve initial timing and transition shifts in one sample domain; use request-owned PCM staging and guard concurrent publication; raise bounded resampling timeout to 300 seconds consistent with bridge bounds. Frozen consumer integration remains required. Evidence is synthetic local audio, not real Kokoro inference.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Primary compatibility audit: do not reject existing XML merely for missing visual IDs. Follow the new canonical source-normalization decision and regression-test the existing Anime, title-slide and transition examples. Normalize before parser flattening; carry assigned IDs downstream. P17 owns full source-content manifest integrity.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Accepted and merged: specification PR2, toolchain PR3, player PR2 and CLI PR3. Primary lint, 58 voiceover tests, 12 positive/23 negative contract checks and semantic vectors passed. Five-package handoff and real Chromium/FFmpeg tone/silence pipelines passed; primary independently verified 36000 samples with 3000 lead zeros, 6000-sample trim, 18000 retained tone samples and 15000 trailing zeros, plus frozen browser red/blue frames despite altered XML times. Handoff: /private/tmp/videoml-p15-handoff/REPORT.md. Real TTS is P16; transition compositing is P07/P08; whole-source bundle integrity is P17. These gates remain open.
